title: Flux Pro v1.1 Ultra Finetuned
description: FLUX1.1 [pro] ultra fine-tuned is the newest version of FLUX1.1 [pro] with a fine-tuned LoRA, maintaining professional-grade image quality while delivering up to 2K resolution with improved photo realism.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated image. 1 being the most strict and 5 being the most permissive.

inputs.name: enhance_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Whether to enhance the prompt for better results.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The image URL to generate an image from.

inputs.name: image_prompt_strength
inputs.tooltip: The strength of the image prompt, between 0 and 1.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated image.

inputs.name: raw
inputs.tooltip: Generate less processed, more natural-looking images.

inputs.name: finetune_strength
inputs.tooltip: Controls finetune influence. Increase this value if your target concept isn't showing up strongly enough. The optimal setting depends on your finetune and prompt
